correctness.rationale: For six exponents (d−1,1),(d−1,0),(1,d−1),(0,d−1),(1,0),(0,1), difference lattice is Z² and polygon normalized area is d²−3. The six sections are basepoint-free on Bl_3 P2 and positive toric edge lengths make L=dH−ΣE ample, so the map is finite, birational and normalized by the smooth toric del Pezzo surface. The second-jet matrix annihilates c=(−1,1,1,−1,−1,1); independent symbolic calculation verified all six rows vanish for symbolic d and a rank-five minor equals (d−2)²(d−1)²/2. Osculating dual arises via inversion and signs. Long edge lattice indices d−2; short-edge transverse valuations d−2,d−1 give K[[s^(d−2),s^(d−1)]], delta (d−3)(d−2)/2. Alternant/Vandermonde identity gives the h_(d−3) contact factor. This is generic boundary data only, not a special-point classification.
